hook.text: Avant-garde jazz in four pieces, each over eight minutes long, the longest nearly twelve minutes.

facts.label: Recorded
facts.value: 21 May 1965, Van Gelder Studio, Englewood Cliffs, NJ

facts.label: Players
facts.value: Sam Rivers (tenor saxophone, soprano saxophone, flute), Freddie Hubbard (trumpet), Herbie Hancock (piano), Ron Carter (bass), Joe Chambers (drums)

sentences.text: Every piece on the record is by Sam Rivers.
The album runs 40 minutes and 8 seconds from start to finish.

listen_for.text: The bonus alternate take on the CD reissue runs 9:04, a little longer than the 8:58 version.
